description: This file defines the IRemindable interface for grains to receive reminders, along with runtime-related interfaces and structs such as IGrainReminder, TickStatus, and ReminderException, that support the reminder mechanism in Orleans.

classes.name: Runtime.TickStatus
classes.description: Represents the status of a reminder tick, including timing information and mechanisms to detect missed ticks.

classes.name: Runtime.ReminderException
classes.description: Exception class used for errors related to Orleans reminders.

methods.name: IRemindable.ReceiveReminder
methods.description: Callback method invoked to deliver a reminder to a grain, with the reminder name and its current status.

methods.name: Runtime.TickStatus constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of TickStatus with the first tick time, period, and current tick time.
